It is also the only display maker with volume positions at both ends of the OLED market: large-area WOLED panels for TVs and monitors, and small and medium flexible AMOLEDs for smartphones, watches, tablets and cars.

title: Carbon Nanotubes as NIR OLED emissive layers
summary: This lecture by Dr. Shabnam Ahadzadeh from Hasselt University, discusses the use of carbon nanotube thin films as an emissive layer in near-infrared (NIR) OLED devices. The talk discusses why CNTs are the "perfect" NIR light emitters, the performance of these devices, and the novel spray-coating based deposition method developed at the University (in collaboration with researchers from the University of Antwerp).

title: Researchers develop an ultrathin, skin-like transparent OLED with 80.7% transmittance
summary: Researchers from China's Northeast Normal University and Jilin Normal University have developed an ultrathin, skin-like transparent OLED. The 2.3 µm thick device transmits 80.7% of light (at 550 nm), which the researchers say is higher than any earlier flexible transparent OLED, and it can be laminated directly on skin.

title: Researchers develop a novel non-destructive way to calculate the lifetime of blue phosphorescent OLEDs
summary: Researchers from KAIST with colleagues from Hanbat National University, Kyung Hee University, and the Applied Surface Technology Ascend (ASTA) institute have developed a novel non-destructive methods to find the lifetime of blue phosphorescent OLED devices. This could lead to faster and cheaper way to design new PHOLED emitters, as there's no need for long age tests.

summary: Huawei announced its new flagship Mate 90 smartphone family. All three phone models sport high-end LTPO AMOLED displays, produced by BOE. title: Toyota targets 1,000 e-Palette sales ahead of 2027 autonomous launch
summary: Toyota Motor Corp. plans to sell 1,000 units of its compact electric bus, the e-Palette, within five to six years as it prepares to introduce a Level 4 autonomous driving version in fiscal 2027, which runs from April 2027 through March 2028. The target is more than 10 times the vehicle's current sales, positioning the e-Palette for broader use in mobility services across Japan.

title: Luxnet posts record 3Q profit as capacity expansion fuels growth
summary: Optical communications maker Luxnet reported a September 2026 net profit attributable to parent-company owners of NT$103 million (US$3.21 million), up 110.2% year-over-year, with earnings per share (EPS) of NT$0.72. September EPS exceeded half of the second-quarter 2026 EPS of NT$1.29, signaling strong momentum in the second half of the year.

title: TSMC bars capacity resale, aims to leave no AI money on the table
summary: TSMC will not let customers sublease or auction off their wafer capacity allocations, chairman C.C. Wei said during the company's October 15 earnings call. With AI chip demand still far outstripping supply, Wei said TSMC intends to leave no food on the table, making as much as it can, as fast as it can.

title: TSMC investor conference: TSMC lifts 2026 revenue growth forecast to 44%, 2nm expansion, new 3nm fab
summary: TSMC Chairman and CEO C.C. Wei announced that, driven by relentless AI momentum and strong demand for advanced process technologies, the company has raised its full-year 2026 US dollar revenue growth guidance to approximately 44%. AI and leading-edge nodes continue to serve as the core growth pillars for the foundry's operations.

title: OpenAI pledges not to use Apple secrets, accuses ex-employee of taking files
summary: Apple's trade-secret lawsuit against OpenAI went to a hearing, where OpenAI pledged not to use confidential information that Apple claims was stolen. OpenAI also accused a former employee of taking more than 100 documents related to unreleased products when joining Apple.

title: EU seeks China deal to lift ASML supplier sanctions amid rare-earth crisis
summary: The European Union (EU) is negotiating with China to lift sanctions on Sindlhauser Materials GmbH, a small German business that is part of ASML's supply chain, according to people familiar with the matter. In exchange, the EU would remove trade restrictions on a Chinese company previously accused of assisting Russia's war against Ukraine.

title: AI agents in suspected Tencent Cloud sandbox target Alibaba’s Amap mapping service
summary: An international AI research team has detected a fleet of more than a dozen AI agents operating in a suspected Tencent Cloud infrastructure sandbox and repeatedly attempting to penetrate Amap, the mapping service owned by Alibaba Group Holding Ltd.

title: Aurotek posts record 3Q26 revenue, up 58% on automation demand
summary: Aurotek Corp. reported record consolidated revenue of NT$1.113 billion (US$34.7 million) in the third quarter of 2026, up 57.93% from a year earlier. Orders from semiconductor, high-end artificial intelligence (AI) server and electronics manufacturing customers drove demand for the company's automation equipment and subsystems.

title: FIC Group opens Malaysia plant as optical module capacity targets 18 SMT lines
summary: FIC Group opened its PRO3C (Malaysia) Sdn. Bhd. manufacturing facility in Johor, Malaysia, on October 15, expanding its optical communications production footprint in Southeast Asia. The Johor Bahru site is designed to support global customers with 800G, 1.6T, 3.2T and 6.4T optical communication modules as demand grows across artificial intelligence, high-performance computing, data centers and semiconductor applications.

title: Trump says Taiwan will buy 30% of LNG output from Alaska project; Taipei confirms plans but not final terms

summary: Taiwan's connector and server-chassis suppliers posted broadly higher September revenue, although their growth trajectories differed. BizLink, AIC and Chenbro had already exceeded their full-year 2025 revenue, while Argosy remained below last year's levels.

title: TSMC CEO says profitability has no ceiling, plans High-NA EUV adoption in 2030
summary: TSMC chairman and CEO C.C. Wei said on October 15 that the chipmaker sees no ceiling on its profitability as demand for AI accelerators continues to outpace supply. Wei also said AI-related growth could exceed the company's long-term forecast and outlined plans to adopt high-numerical-aperture extreme ultraviolet (High-NA EUV) lithography in 2030.

title: SK Hynix reportedly ties US NAND fab plan to approval for chip equipment exports to China
summary: SK Hynix is seeking US approval to ship additional American chipmaking equipment to its NAND flash facility in Dalian, China, linking the request to a potential investment in a new US factory, Reuters reported on October 15, citing two people familiar with the matter.

title: AI server tracker: Taiwanese ODM/EMS players post NT$2.18T in September 2026, up 56% YoY
summary: Six Taiwanese server and networking contract manufacturers booked combined revenue of NT$2.18 trillion (US$67.3 billion) in September 2026, up 55.9% year-over-year and 4.9% month-over-month, as demand for AI servers stayed strong. Nine-month revenue of NT$15.5 trillion already exceeds the group's full-year 2025 total of NT$14.3 trillion.

title: Applied Materials CEO says agentic AI drives wafer demand
summary: Applied Materials CEO Gary Dickerson said customer demand to produce more good dies per wafer and rapidly expand wafer output has reached levels unprecedented in his career, driven by the rise of AI computing. Speaking at a global investor conference, he said the company expects revenue from related businesses to grow by more than 20% over the next several years.

title: India's RRP Electronics opens advanced wafer-level packaging facility in Navi Mumbai
summary: India's RRP Electronics has inaugurated an Advanced Wafer-Level Packaging (AWLP) facility at its semiconductor unit in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, adding SIM and eSIM module production and specialized testing to its outsourced semiconductor assembly and test (OSAT) operations. The facility opened on October 12, 2026, according to Dalal Street Investment Journal.
